title: Yoroiden Samurai Troopers: Complete Volume
originalTitle: 鎧伝サムライトルーパー　完結編
summary: The companion to the Appearance Volume, covering episodes 20-39 with a poster calendar, story digest, the Touma-and-armor story 'Bridge Connecting Heaven and Earth', reader material, commentary, and setting pages. It receives extra credit for Shioyama cover art, a Murase inner cover, more original illustrations, and the added prose story.
